title: Young Couple, Flapper Drop-Waist Dress Porch - Vintage 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a stylish young couple from the Roaring Twenties standing along a walkway beside a wooden house porch. The man wears a light flat cap, collared shirt with a necktie, and dark trousers, while the young woman sports a cropped, waved flapper bob and a classic late 1920s drop-waist dress with decorative skirt pleats paired with dark Mary Jane strap shoes. Architectural details include a louvered shutter, exposed wooden porch post, and brick foundation, capturing quintessential 1920s American domestic life and youth fashion.
